d.why: Only in Spider-Man (1994) S3E12 'The Spot', where she is the Kingpin's hostage whom Johnathon Ohnn turns on Fisk to rescue, and her choice to follow him into the rift ends the episode; she is also the Spot's partner.
Appears in Spider-Man (1994) S3E6 (flashback) and S3E7 as the corrupt agent framing Peter, plus a memory cameo in S3E8.
Appears in Spider-Man (1994) S5E4-E6 with the Six American Warriors.
Appears in Spider-Man (1994) S2E11-E12 (plus a photo in S3E7) and is the Kingpin's wife and Richard Fisk's mother.
On screen only in Spider-Man (1994) S3E4, where he is Norman's Oscorp scientist on the gas who is pulled from the fire; the S3E13 glimpse is a flashback, and he is Norman's employee, not his boss.
Appears in Spider-Man (1994) S5E4-E6 with the Six American Warriors.
Appears in Spider-Man (1994) S5E2, E3, E4 and E5, and is Illyena Groitzig's father.
Only in Spider-Man Unlimited S1E11, where he is the antagonist who splits Eddie Brock from the Venom symbiote and holds it in his lab until Spider-Man steals it back.
Only in Spider-Man Unlimited S1E10, where he is the long-lost brother Daniel goes to free and the episode's twist villain who betrays Daniel and Spider-Man before drowning.
Only in Spider-Man Unlimited S1E7, where he is the episode's new villain, the dragon Bestial running Sir Ram's kidnapping front whom Spider-Man and the Vulture fight and defeat.
Appears in Spider-Man Unlimited S1E1 and in a flashback in S1E10 (mentioned in E2 and E11), and is Peter Parker's wife.
Only in Spider-Man Unlimited S1E1, where he briefly tries to stop Spider-Man taking the shuttle and lets himself be talked round.
On screen only in Spider-Man Unlimited S1E9 (just mentioned in E13), where she leads the Rejects, the episode's central secret, who seize Spider-Man and the Goblin and take them on the raid.
Appears in The Spectacular Spider-Man S1E1 (cameo), S1E11 and S1E12.
Appears in The Spectacular Spider-Man S2E3, S2E10 and S2E11.
Appears in The Spectacular Spider-Man S2E1, E4, E8, E12 and E13.
Appears in The Spectacular Spider-Man S2E1, E2, E6, E11 and E13.
Appears in The Spectacular Spider-Man S2E7 and S2E9.
Only in The Spectacular Spider-Man S2E8, where he wins the auction for the Rhino specs and becomes the target Hammerhead, Silver Sable and the Rhino chase, fooling them with an empty box.
Appears in The Spectacular Spider-Man S1E7 (cameo) and S2E1, E2, E5, E6, E7, E9, E10, E12 and E13.
Appears in The Spectacular Spider-Man S1E11 and S2E5, E6, E7, E11 and E12.

Only in Peter's origin flashback in The Spectacular Spider-Man S1E12 (S2E12 has just a brief flashback), where as the wrestling promoter he refuses to pay Peter in a short scene of someone else's story.
Only in The Spectacular Spider-Man S1E8, where he tells Doctor Octopus where the Megalo-pack is and goes into hiding, but he is kept as the head of Tricorp and Otto Octavius's former employer.
Appears in X-Men: The Animated Series S2E10, E12 and E13, and also in X-Men '97 S1E5.
Appears in X-Men: The Animated Series S4E1 and S4E2 (S4E8 is only a recap).
Appears in X-Men: The Animated Series S2E6, E12 and E13.
Appears in X-Men: The Animated Series S4E8, E10 and E11, where he is revealed as Immortus.
